title: Equal finite stalk ranks in Picard base change
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $E$ be finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], $g:T\to S$, and assume $R(f,E,g)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. Let $h:T'\to T$, $t\in T'$, and $F=E$ or $F=E^\vee$. Set $p=\operatorname{pr}_2:X\times_S T\to T$, $q=\operatorname{pr}_1:X\times_S T\to X$, and $p',v$ the two projections of $(X\times_S T)\times_T T'$. Put $P=h^*p_*q^*F$ and $Q=p'_*v^*q^*F$. Use the module stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and the canonical ordinary map $\beta:P\to Q$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction]. The $\mathcal O_{T',t}$-module $Q_t$ is finitely generated, and there exists an $\mathcal O_{T',t}$-linear equivalence $P_t\cong Q_t$. No assertion about $\beta_t$ is made.

proof.text: Obtain a finite basis for each stalk separately from lem-sc-picard-base-change-stalk-finite-bases. Obtain equality of the stalk finranks from lem-sc-picard-base-change-stalk-finrank-eq. Module.finrank_eq_card_basis and Fintype.card_fin identify the two basis cardinalities, so substitute the equality. Module.Finite.of_basis proves finite generation of Q_t, and Module.Basis.equiv along Equiv.refl gives the required linear equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem picardRankMatch_baseChange_stalk_ranks {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S)
    (hR : PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g) {T' : Scheme.{u}} (h : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : F = E ∨ F = Modules.dual E) (t : T') :
    let P := (Modules.tensorPullback h).obj
      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f g)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F))
    let Q := (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)).obj
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F))
    Module.Finite (T'.presheaf.stalk t) (Q.presheaf.stalk t) ∧
      Nonempty (P.presheaf.stalk t ≃ₗ[T'.presheaf.stalk t] Q.presheaf.stalk t)
